Local de trabalho: São Paulo, SP - Modelo híbrido.

A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.

Comprometida com a sustentabilidade, a Hyundai iniciou medidas para liderar uma era de mobilidade mais sustentável eletrificando sua linha de produtos e expandindo seus negócios de hidrogênio para veículos comerciais e dispositivos de utilidade. Além da mobilidade, confiaremos na economia circular para moldar um futuro mais sustentável que beneficiará não apenas a Hyundai como empresa, mas a sociedade como um todo.

A Hyundai Motor Brasil começou suas operações em 2012, introduzindo o modelo único HB20 no mercado local, projetado e desenvolvido especificamente para o país. Atualmente, a empresa atua como sede regional para a América Central e do Sul, exportando do Brasil para Uruguai, Paraguai, Colômbia e México. Com perspectivas promissoras para a região, a Hyundai Motor Brasil, também conhecida como Hyundai Motor Central & South América, está introduzindo tecnologia de ponta de modelos premiados mundialmente, como o IONIQ 5, e avançando para implementar soluções movidas a hidrogênio junto com ações sociais e ambientais para contribuir com as sociedades onde opera na região. Se você aspira fazer parte de uma equipe líder em inovação na indústria automotiva, venha se juntar a nós na Hyundai e faça parte desta jornada rumo ao sucesso.

Movimento audacioso, energia positiva e trabalho de qualidade; este é o nosso DNA Hyundai; este foi o poder que nos permitiu ser líder global na indústria automotiva e será o poder para criar um novo mundo. Estamos em busca de talentos que escreverão uma nova página de nossa história com o DNA Hyundai.

Venha crescer conosco!!!

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
About Us

Pocket FM is the world's largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.

At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.

Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.

Role Overview

As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.

2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.

3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble

4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.

5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.

6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.

8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology

9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.

10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery

Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.

Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.

Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.

Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English

This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Data Specialist (with Advanced English)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

About the Role:

We're currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs.

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!

As Our Data Specialist, you will:

  • Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that's running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients' key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You'll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it.
  • Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You'll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here.
  • Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients, working with them to identify and answer key questions. You'll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world.
  • Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and PySpark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors
  • You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter
  • You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized
  • You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Head of Business & Operations (Brazil Resident)
description:
About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.

Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.

What you'll do

  • Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil
  • Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline
  • Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company

What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one
  • Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes
  • Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

title: Email Marketing Designer
description:
Email Marketing Designer

Full-Time | 40 hrs/week | Remote and US business hours | Long-Term Contract

About the Role

Our client, a high-growth, 8-figure DTC apparel brand, is looking for a highly experienced Graphic Designer to join their email marketing and paid-ads creative team full-time. This role plays a key part in executing high-frequency campaigns that reflect the brand's voice and drive results across email and paid channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-quality email graphics and layouts in Figma, aligned with campaign objectives
  • Translate monthly marketing briefs into compelling visual executions
  • Prepare and integrate final designs into Klaviyo for email campaign flows
  • Work closely with the email marketing team to execute lifecycle campaigns
  • Ensure visuals reflect brand voice and customer nuance
  • Support paid media creative assets
  • Support social media graphics and promotional assets
  • Contribute to creative execution for product launches and seasonal campaigns
  • Execute quickly and efficiently in a high-frequency campaign environment
  • Apply strategic thinking to every email — including CTA hierarchy, personalization, and urgency — not just visual execution
  • Own the full range of lifecycle email types: welcome/onboarding, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, cross-sell, and win-back

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong focus on email marketing or lifecycle campaigns
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (primary design tool for this role)
  • Strong attention to detail and brand alignment
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven DTC environment
  • Ability to collaborate closely with lifecycle/email marketing teams
  • Strong execution discipline, consistency, and speed of delivery
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce email marketing strategy (CTA hierarchy, personalization, urgency, friction reduction) — not purely visual design
  • Experience supporting eCommerce brands at scale, ideally $500K+ in monthly revenue
  • Fluent English communication (written and verbal) for daily collaboration with a US-based team

Nice to Have

  • Experience preparing and integrating designs into Klaviyo
  • Familiarity with Canva as a secondary design tool

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a seasoned designer with deep, hands-on experience creating high-quality email marketing creatives — not a generalist. They work confidently in Figma, understand how their designs flow into email platforms like Klaviyo, and take ownership of their output from concept to final asset. They're comfortable juggling multiple campaigns at once and thrive in the rhythm of a fast-paced DTC brand.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor – Social Media & Content

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Schedule: 40 hours/week

About the Client

Our client is a marketing and creative agency that helps brands grow through a combination of digital marketing, social media, content creation, video production, paid media, and creative design.

The agency works with brands across different industries, developing engaging, social-first content designed to build audiences, increase brand visibility, and support business growth.

The team is currently expanding its video production capabilities to support a new college-focused social app. The project will involve creating authentic, engaging short-form content featuring college campuses, student conversations, street interviews, and promotional material.

About the Role

We are looking for a Short-Form Video Editor to join the creative team and support the launch of a new social app designed for college students.

The primary focus of this role will be editing short-form social media content for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

You will work with raw footage, often recorded on phones or other lightweight equipment, and turn it into polished, engaging content that feels natural to a young U.S. audience.

A strong understanding of social media culture, Gen Z content, pacing, storytelling, and current short-form video trends is important for this role.

Candidates with previous experience editing street interviews, man-on-the-street content, campus videos, interviews, UGC, or youth-oriented social content are especially encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.
  • Turn raw phone-shot and camera footage into polished, engaging social content.
  • Edit college campus tours, street interviews, student conversations, promotional videos, and UGC-style content.
  • Review large amounts of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, reactions, quotes, and answers.
  • Create strong hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds.
  • Build a clear and engaging story from multiple clips.
  • Use jump cuts, hard cuts, B-roll, and pacing to maintain viewer attention.
  • Cut footage to music and beats when appropriate.
  • Add captions, subtitles, text overlays, and other social-first elements.
  • Perform basic color correction and audio cleanup.
  • Maintain consistency in visual quality, pacing, and editing style across content.
  • Repurpose footage into multiple short-form pieces when appropriate.
  • Incorporate feedback and revisions efficiently.
  • Manage a high volume of content during the app's launch period.
  • Potentially support video projects for other agency clients as the role develops.

Requirements

  • Proven experience editing short-form social media content.
  • Strong proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable Adobe video-editing software.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and visual rhythm.
  • Ability to turn raw footage into engaging short-form content.
  • Experience with basic color correction and audio editing.
  • Ability to work effectively with phone-shot, raw, and imperfect footage.
  • Good understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other short-form formats.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while taking direction and incorporating feedback.
  • Strong English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience editing street interviews or man-on-the-street videos.
  • Experience with college, campus, student, Gen Z, lifestyle, dating, social, or UGC content.
  • Experience editing interviews and multi-person conversations.
  • Experience working with high-volume social media content.
  • Familiarity with Adobe After Effects.
  • Basic motion graphics and animation skills.
  • Experience creating engaging captions and animated text.
  • Strong awareness of current TikTok and Instagram editing trends.

The ideal candidate knows how to:

  • Start with a strong hook.
  • Remove unnecessary pauses, filler, and dead space.
  • Keep conversations moving with natural cuts and jump cuts.
  • Identify the funniest, most interesting, surprising, or relatable moments.
  • Combine multiple interview responses into a cohesive story.
  • Use B-roll strategically.
  • Add clean, readable captions.
  • Use music and sound effects when they enhance the content.
  • Keep the content authentic and conversational.
  • Avoid excessive transitions, effects, and animations when they don't add value.

title: People Partner (Brazil)
description:

title: Director of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships

WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies
  • Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results
  • Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate
  • Remote-first with regional travel as required
  • Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one
  • A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM

MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Process and Automation Consultant (3 months)
description:
We are seeking a Process and Automation Consultant – RPA Specialist to join a three‐month advisory engagement that supports the migration of the core pricing system. The consultant will own the end‐to‐end documentation of current pricing and agreement processes, uncover manual pain points , and design automation‐ready future‐state workflows. The role reports to the engagement lead and works closely with operational teams , the client's internal stakeholders, and external implementation vendors.

Key Responsibilities

Document current‐state end‐to‐end pricing and agreement processes, including handoffs, exception paths, and workarounds. Quantify manual effort, cycle times, rework, and error rates using available data sources. Conduct structured process‐discovery workshops with operational teams to surface bottlenecks and improvement ideas. Identify and evaluate automation opportunities (RPA, workflow orchestration, rules‐based validation) and assess their long‐term viability. Design future‐state workflow alternatives that support agreement intake, validation, approval, and publication. Prioritize automation and redesign initiatives with effort, impact, and risk estimates. Distinguish automation that resolves root causes from automation that merely masks underlying process defects. Produce validated documentation and present findings to senior stakeholders for decision‐making.

Job Requirements

Minimum 6 years of experience in business process analysis, process improvement, or intelligent‐automation consulting. Advanced English proficiency (C1 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to create process maps using BPMN, value‐stream mapping, SIPOC, or comparable

techniques. Hands‐on experience delivering RPA solutions with platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or similar. Demonstrated capability to lead and facilitate structured workshops with cross‐functional operational teams. Strong analytical skills to quantify manual effort, cycle times, and error rates.

Preferred Skills

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. Direct experience in pricing, rebates, or order‐to‐cash operations. Exposure to process‐mining tools such as Celonis or comparable solutions. Familiarity with workflow‐orchestration platforms (e.g., Camunda, Microsoft Power Automate).

This is an ideal position for Mechanical, Civil, Sanitary, or Fire Protection Engineers with hands-on experience in fire protection design (RCI/PCI) and BIM coordination.

  • Design, model, and coordinate fire sprinkler and fire suppression systems for commercial and residential U.S. projects.
  • Apply NFPA standards (particularly NFPA 13, 14 & 20) to develop fully compliant, constructible designs.
  • Perform clash detection and spatial coordination with Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Structural disciplines using Navisworks.
  • Proactively review plans to identify design conflicts and develop practical engineering solutions before construction.
  • Conduct QA/QC reviews to eliminate modeling errors and maintain organized project documentation/revisions.

What You'll Bring

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical, Civil, Sanitary, or Fire Protection Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent practical design experience.

title: Product Owner (PO)
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para liderar a implementação da Reforma Tributária em nossos sistemas. O profissional será responsável por traduzir as exigências fiscais e as Normas Técnicas publicadas pelos órgãos reguladores em requisitos claros e acionáveis para os times de desenvolvimento, garantindo que nossas soluções estejam em conformidade com a nova legislação dentro dos prazos definidos pelo cronograma de transição.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como ponte entre a área fiscal/tributária e os times técnicos, traduzindo Normas Técnicas, notas técnicas e legislações (IBS, CBS, Split Payment, entre outras) em requisitos de produto e histórias de usuário.
  • Priorizar e gerenciar o backlog de implementação da Reforma Tributária, equilibrando prazos regulatórios, complexidade técnica e impacto no negócio.
  • Acompanhar as publicações de Notas Técnicas, layouts e atualizações de schemas (NF-e, NFC-e, CT-e, entre outros documentos fiscais) e avaliar seus impactos nos sistemas.
  • Definir critérios de aceite e validar entregas junto aos times de desenvolvimento e QA.
  • Interagir com stakeholders internos (fiscal, jurídico, contabilidade, TI) e, quando necessário, externos (consultorias tributárias, fornecedores de ERP/ferramentas fiscais).
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (refinamento, planning, review) relacionadas à frente de reforma tributária.
  • Monitorar o cronograma de transição da Reforma Tributária (fases de teste, coexistência e vigência plena) e garantir que as entregas estejam alinhadas aos marcos legais.
  • Produzir documentação clara sobre as mudanças implementadas, para times internos e áreas de negócio.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner, Analista de Negócios ou função correlata, preferencialmente em produtos/sistemas fiscais ou tributários.
  • Conhecimento fiscal sólido, com familiaridade em tributos sobre consumo (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, ISS) e, idealmente, nos fundamentos da Reforma Tributária (IBS, CBS, Imposto Seletivo).
  • Capacidade comprovada de leitura e interpretação de Normas Técnicas, legislações e documentação regulatória, traduzindo-as em requisitos técnicos.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares).
  • Boa comunicação, com facilidade para dialogar tanto com áreas fiscais/jurídicas quanto com times técnicos.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e proativo na antecipação de riscos regulatórios.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de adequação a mudanças fiscais anteriores (ex.: implantação de NF-e, e-Social, EFD-Reinf).
  • Conhecimento em sistemas ERP e módulos fiscais.
  • Formação ou pós-graduação em Direito Tributário, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Certificação em Product Ownership (PSPO, CSPO ou similar).

Modalidade: 100% remoto

title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They're among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We're looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk
  • Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models
  • Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring
  • Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls
  • Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments
  • Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance
  • Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact
  • Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs
  • Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite
  • Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need

  • Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm
  • Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages
  • A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields
  • Fluency in English

Nice to have

  • Experience in the second line of defence (risk)
  • Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Supervisor (a) de Manutenção (Florestal)
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Supervisionar as atividades operacionais de manutenção mecânica.
  • Supervisionar as atividades operacionais de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, abastecimento e lubrificação.
  • Definir a priorização na execução das atividades, assegurando a continuidade operacional.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das periodicidades e das instruções operacionais.
  • Gerenciar informações de produção diária, consumo de materiais, combustíveis, dos equipamentos e mão de obra.
  • Realizar, de forma esporádica, o carregamento e/ou descarregamento das máquinas em veículos de transporte.
  • Analisar indicadores e apoiar na gestão de custos e elaboração do plano operativo. Supervisionar contratos de prestação de serviço.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino técnico completo ou superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Gestão da Manutenção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em atividades de manutenção de máquinas e equipamentos florestais.
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em planejamento e controle de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva.
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de desempenho de manutenção.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office.
  • CNH categoria B.

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas de Campo - Juazeiro/BA
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Requisitos:

Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação: Juazeiro/BA

Nós lhe propomos:

title: Gerente de Controladoria e Finanças
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A NoPing é uma plataforma de otimização de conexão e desempenho para jogos online. Há mais de dez anos no mercado gamer, utiliza tecnologias de inteligência artificial e multiconexão para reduzir ping, packet loss e desconexões, além de aumentar o FPS. Com suporte para mais de 4 mil jogos, a solução está disponível para PC e dispositivos móveis, oferecendo uma experiência mais rápida e estável em apenas três cliques.

A oportunidade

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Gerente de Controladoria e Finanças assumindo a liderança das áreas Financeira e de Controladoria da NoPing. Essa posição terá papel estratégico na estruturação e profissionalização dos processos financeiros, garantindo maior previsibilidade, controle e qualidade das informações para apoiar as decisões e o crescimento da companhia.

Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar e liderar o planejamento financeiro e orçamentário, incluindo orçamento, forecast, realizado versus planejado e projeções de fluxo de caixa;
  • Acompanhar e analisar as demonstrações financeiras e contábeis, garantindo qualidade e integração das informações junto à contabilidade;
  • Gerenciar contas a pagar, faturamento e pagamentos de fornecedores, colaboradores e demais compromissos financeiros da companhia;
  • Estruturar e padronizar políticas, processos, rotinas, calendários, controles e governança financeira.
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com bancos, instituições financeiras, fornecedores, parceiros estratégicos e contabilidade;
  • Realizar análises de custos, margens, rentabilidade e resultados, inclusive por produto, operação e país;
  • Participar da precificação dos produtos da NoPing, considerando custos, margens, mercados e particularidades regionais;
  • Criar e acompanhar indicadores financeiros, operacionais e contábeis, além de dashboards e soluções de BI financeiro em conjunto com Tecnologia;
  • Preparar análises, indicadores e apresentações executivas para acompanhamento dos resultados e suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Garantir a evolução e o correto uso do ERP Nasajon, promovendo integração, centralização, automação e confiabilidade das informações;
  • Organizar documentos, controles e processos para preparação da companhia para auditorias;
  • Apoiar análises de captação de recursos, reestruturações financeiras e oportunidades de financiamento;
  • Acompanhar a estrutura financeira dos diferentes CNPJs, bem como estruturar e evoluir as operações financeiras internacionais;
  • Avaliar gateways, meios de pagamento e estruturas financeiras adequadas e eficientes para os diferentes países de atuação;
  • Identificar gaps e oportunidades de melhoria, buscando uma operação financeira estruturada, padronizada, automatizada e orientada por dados;
  • Liderar e desenvolver o time financeiro, definindo responsabilidades, processos, indicadores e prioridades.

Habilidades Necessárias:

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Finanças, Controladoria, FP&A ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com Gestão e desenvolvimento de Pessoas;
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em planejamento financeiro, orçamento, forecast e gestão de fluxo de caixa, garantindo previsibilidade e acompanhamento dos resultados;
  • Conhecimento de demonstrações financeiras e contábeis, com capacidade de analisar custos, margens, rentabilidade e desempenho do negócio;
  • Vivência na gestão de contas a pagar, faturamento e conciliações financeiras, assegurando organização e eficiência das rotinas;
  • Experiência na construção e acompanhamento de KPIs financeiros, transformando dados em análises e direcionamentos para a tomada de decisão;
  • Vivência com ERP, estruturação de processos e controles financeiros, buscando maior padronização, confiabilidade e eficiência operacional;
  • Capacidade de elaborar análises, relatórios e apresentações executivas, comunicando informações financeiras de forma clara para diferentes áreas e lideranças;
  • Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes, com capacidade de organizar responsabilidades, prioridades e entregas em ambiente 100% remoto;
  • Perfil analítico e estratégico, aliado à organização, agilidade e forte capacidade de execução;
  • Autonomia, senso de dono e capacidade de resolução de problemas, conduzindo melhorias e apoiando a evolução da área;
  • Afinidade com tecnologia, dados e automação, buscando otimizar processos e aumentar a qualidade das informações;
  • Boa comunicação, resiliência e capacidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, de crescimento e constante evolução.

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência com empresas que possuem operações internacionais;
  • Conhecimento sobre estruturas financeiras e contábeis internacionais;

O que Oferecemos

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Compliance team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to manage conduct risk.

We're looking for a Regulatory Compliance Manager to keep our consumer protection practice in compliance. You'll advise on crypto compliance requirements and related controls.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Developing and executing a world-class compliance framework, monitoring, and training programme
  • Supporting regulatory licence applications
  • Monitoring, testing, and reporting on the effectiveness of our regulatory architecture
  • Drafting, implementing, and rolling out compliance plans, frameworks, and policies
  • Providing expert regulatory advice to the Operations teams to support product launches
  • Collaborating with international product teams to navigate cross-border compliance requirements
  • Supporting the Head of Compliance in rolling out a robust compliance programme

What you'll need

  • 4+ years of experience advising on compliance-related matters
  • The ability to analyse and interpret data to guide regulatory strategy
  • A solid understanding of the interplay between compliance risk and business risk
  • The ability to communicate positively with regulators and members of various internal teams
  • Excellent analytical skills with a proven track record of learning complex, new regulations quickly

Nice to have

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

title: Gerente de Manutenção e Ferramental
description:
Gerenciar e otimizar as atividades de manutenção e ferramental com foco em sólidos farmacêuticos, garantindo confiabilidade dos equipamentos, disponibilidade industrial, conformidade regulatória e suporte contínuo à produção.

Você será responsável por liderar a estratégia de manutenção (preventiva, preditiva e corretiva), atuar na melhoria de indicadores (OEE, MTBF/MTTR, disponibilidade e custo) e assegurar que o ferramental esteja sempre apto para operar dentro dos requisitos de BPF e de auditorias.

  • Gerenciar o planejamento e a execução da manutenção de equipamentos e utilidades críticos do processo de sólidos (ex.: granulação, compressão, revestimento, embalagem e sistemas associados).
  • Definir e sustentar a estratégia de manutenção preventiva e preditiva, estabelecendo rotinas, padrões e critérios de intervenção.
  • Atuar na liderança de planos de melhoria contínua para redução de quebras, perdas e paradas não programadas, acompanhando indicadores como MTBF, MTTR, disponibilidade e custos.
  • Garantir gestão eficaz do ferramental (revisões, calibração/verificações aplicáveis, vida útil, rastreabilidade e controle de alterações), assegurando conformidade para produção e trocas.
  • Gerenciar gestão de sobressalentes e criticidade de ativos, garantindo níveis adequados de estoque e resposta rápida a falhas.
  • Conduzir e/ ou apoiar investigações de falhas e desvios (CAPA), com foco em causa raiz e prevenção de recorrência.
  • Assegurar conformidade com BPF, procedimentos internos, gestão documental e prontidão para auditorias.
  • Liderar equipe e interfaces (produção, qualidade, engenharia, fornecedores e manutenção terceirizada quando aplicável), promovendo cultura de segurança e disciplina operacional.
  • Elaborar e controlar orçamento de manutenção, projetos de melhoria e contratos de serviços, garantindo execução com qualidade e previsibilidade.
  • Formação superior completa (Engenharias, Administração, áreas correlatas) e experiência comprovada em manutenção industrial.
  • Experiência em ambiente farmacêutico, com atuação específica em sólidos (processos e/ou equipamentos típicos de comprimidos/cápsulas).
  • Conhecimento sólido de estratégias de manutenção: TPM, manutenção preventiva, preditiva, planos de inspeção e gestão de ativos.
  • Vivência com BPF, documentação GMP, gestão de desvios e interface com Qualidade (CAPA, investigação de falhas).
  • Capacidade de liderar equipes e projetos, com foco em indicadores e melhoria contínua (ex.: 5 porquês, Ishikawa, PDCA, RCM/criticidade quando aplicável).
  • Experiência com gestão de ferramental e/ou controle de mudanças (rastreabilidade, revisão/uso, padronização e conformidade para produção).

title: Operador(a) de Produção de Painéis
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então inscreva-se nesta oportunidade!

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Executar as atividades pertinentes a fabricação dos produtos podendo operar máquinas e/ou equipamentos conforme instrução de trabalho.
  • Acionar e apoiar a equipe de manutenção quando necessário, assegurando todos os procedimentos de segurança para o apoio a estas atividades.
  • Realizar apontamentos das informações sobre segurança, qualidade, produtividade e consumo reportando ao superior imediato as não conformidades e sugestões de melhoria.
  • Realizar a classificação do material conforme as especificações e procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Realizar o check list de inspeção e planos de limpeza diário.
  • Participar da rotina semanal de limpeza de equipamentos críticos.
  • Participar em projetos de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Disponibilidade de horário para trabalhar em turnos 6x2.

title: Email Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As an Email Designer at Lilo Social, you will be the creative force behind high-converting email experiences for our portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will transform strategic concepts into beautiful, mobile-optimized email designs that drive engagement, revenue, and long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with retention strategists and copywriters, you will craft email templates that balance brand aesthetics with performance-driven design principles.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high email engagement rates (open rates, click rates) across your client portfolio through strong visual design
  • Efficient production workflows that allow rapid iteration and testing of design variations
  • Email designs that maintain brand consistency while optimizing for conversion and user experience
  • Positive client feedback on design quality and strong collaboration with cross-functional team members

Responsibilities

  • Create campaign emails, automated flow templates, and promotional designs aligned with client brand guidelines
  • Develop mobile-first email designs that render flawlessly across email clients and devices
  • Collaborate with retention strategists and copywriters to bring campaign concepts to life
  • Iterate quickly on email designs based on performance data and A/B test results
  • Maintain organized design systems and asset libraries for each client account
  • Build reusable email modules and components that streamline production
  • Ensure all emails meet accessibility standards and deliverability best practices
  • Stay current on email design trends, platform updates, and industry innovations
  • Execute QA testing across multiple email clients before campaign launches
  • Support the team with design feedback and contribute to internal design standards
  • Manage multiple client accounts with varying design needs and brand aesthetics

Requirements

  • 2-4 years of experience in email design, digital design, or related field with a strong portfolio demonstrating email work
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for designing email layouts and creating design systems
  • Strong grasp of email marketing best practices including mobile optimization, CTA placement, and visual hierarchy
  • Demonstrated ability to design for conversion while maintaining brand integrity and aesthetic quality
  • Fast iteration speed with ability to produce high-quality work under tight timelines
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across devices
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with strategists, copywriters, and account teams
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer brands and ecommerce customer lifecycle marketing

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or other email service platforms (Mailchimp, Iterable, Braze)
  • Motion graphics or animation capabilities to enhance email interactivity and engagement
  • Experience designing for SMS, push notifications, or other retention marketing channels
  • Understanding of email deliverability factors and how design choices impact inbox placement

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing
description:
This role is open to candidates based in Brazil only.

About SigmaMD

SigmaMD is changing the way people manage their health. We build the platform where modern clinics run their entire business on — clinician apps, patient apps, and the admin tooling behind them — covering charting, a number of embedded AI tools, e-prescribing, labs, scheduling, patient messaging, and the money.

About this role

We're looking for a senior product designer who wants more than screens. You'll own the design of our most demanding domain end to end — the research, the flows, the interface, and a real share of the product thinking behind it.

Your primary surface is Payments & Billing. Today our practices bill patients and employers directly: memberships and plan cycles, employer contracts with coverage rules, eligibility roster feeds, proration, invoices and charge items, refunds and reissues, superbills, and card/ACH processing through our merchant partner.

This is not a domain you can design from a wireframe kit. When a patient joins on the 14th, when an employer covers 60% up to a cap, when a membership pauses mid-cycle and is reinstated — someone has to understand exactly what the numbers do, then design an interface that makes it obvious to a physician who is not an accountant. That person is you.

And the next chapter is big. We're expanding into full insurance billing — claims submission, eligibility verification, remittance posting, denials workflow, and prior authorization via a clearinghouse partnership — so hybrid practices can run membership revenue and insurance revenue side by side. Designing it is the most interesting problem we can offer.

You won't only touch billing. Money and care delivery are inseparable here: a charge item comes from an order, a superbill comes out of a signed note, eligibility gets checked at booking. Expect to design across the EHR itself wherever it meets the money. Fellow product designers, engineers, QA, and our customer success team are all people you'll collaborate with daily. Nobody reports to you, but we expect seniority to show up as more than shipping: reviewing work, sharing the reasoning behind your decisions, and helping the designers around you grow is part of how this role operates day to day. You get real ownership of your surfaces, and a company small enough that you can take any question straight to the person who can answer it.

What you'll do

Design it.

  • Own the full design arc for Payments & Billing: research, information architecture, flows, prototypes, and production-ready screens in Figma.
  • Make dense, numbers-heavy interfaces feel calm and obvious. A physician should never have to think about how billing works.
  • Extend our design system where the domain demands patterns we don't have yet.

Own the product thinking.

  • Shape the roadmap for your area alongside our team and customers.
  • Write the stories engineering builds from — which field, which state transition, what happens at the boundary, what the money does. Our specs are precise, and designers write them here.
  • Help define our move into insurance billing.

Talk to customers — and onboard them yourself.

  • Be on calls and in writing with US physicians and practice administrators, and personally onboard new practices. Sitting with a physician while they configure their billing is the best research you'll ever run.
  • Turn messy operational complaints into design decisions. Most of our best work starts as a frustrated support thread.

Do the math.

  • Model pricing and fee scenarios, reason about proration and cycle boundaries, and stress-test flows against edge cases before they reach a spec. Ambiguity in a billing interface becomes a real charge on someone's bank account.

Make the design team better.

  • Review other designers' work, explain the why behind your decisions, and share what you know. Some of that is people, and some of it is what the team builds on: the design system, the patterns, the way decisions get documented.
What we're looking for

1. Exceptional written and spoken English — our single most important requirement. You'll be on live calls with US clinicians, writing specs engineers build from, and writing directly to customers. We assess this seriously and early.

2. Startup experience in a design or product role. You've worked somewhere small enough that you owned outcomes, not tickets — where the answer to "who decides this?" was you. Senior Product Designer, Product Manager, Product Owner, or founder all count.

3. A technical background. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read an API contract comfortably, reason about a data model, and hold your own in a technical discussion without deferring. Front-end experience or a CS/Engineering background is a strong plus.

4. Genuinely comfortable with numbers. You'll design around money. You should enjoy — not tolerate — building the spreadsheet, deriving the proration formula, and stress-testing a pricing model against edge cases.

Plus: 5+ years in product design with real ownership of a domain; a portfolio of complex, information-dense product work (not marketing pages); expert Figma; and writing precise enough that a developer never has to guess.

Who you might be

You're a designer who got restless about why you were designing it, and started owning the product decision itself. Maybe you effectively ran the roadmap for your area at a SaaS company. Maybe you co-founded something small and had to be the designer, the front-end developer, and the person who understood the unit economics all at once. What matters is that you've held both halves at once, been close enough to the code to be dangerous, and had to defend a number to someone who cared about it.

Nice to have
  • Revenue cycle management or insurance billing — claims, eligibility, remittance, denials, prior authorization, clearinghouse integrations. This is where we're heading, and the hardest thing on this list to teach.
  • Payments, billing, subscriptions, or fintech (merchant processing, ACH, PCI, benefits eligibility feeds).
  • Healthcare, digital health, or EHR experience
  • Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS, design tokens) and design-system authorship.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted workflows for research, spec writing, and analysis.
Our values

Teamwork, empathy, and innovation — and caring that on the other end of every decision is a physician trying to run an independent practice and their patients.

title: 11335 - Analista de RH (Sênior)
description:

title: Gerente de frota
description:
(Empresa Confidencial)

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Frotas capaz de equilibrar a pressão do dia a dia com a visão de longo prazo, liderar uma equipe distribuída geograficamente e estar dois passos à frente na adoção de tecnologia, além de estar responsável pelo ciclo completo: desde a aquisição à desmobilização, passando pela performance operacional, gestão de custos e desenvolvimento da equipe.

É um cargo para quem quer deixar marca! Venha fazer parte desse time.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Garantir a excelência operacional ponta a ponta nas operações logísticas, atuando na gestão e na construção de processos, assegurando nível de serviço, eficiência de custos, segurança e qualidade, com foco em crescimento sustentável.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Planejamento e gestão da frota: elaborar o plano de expansão e renovação, definir a composição por modal (motos, vans e elétricos), planejar investimentos (Capex/Opex), avaliar aquisição, locação e substituição de veículos, além de conduzir estudos e testes de novos modelos e otimizar a distribuição dos ativos entre as bases.
  • Gestão financeira: controlar o custo total de propriedade (TCO), monitorar indicadores de custos (custo por km, manutenção e indisponibilidade), implementar ações de redução de despesas, avaliar modelos de contratação da frota, aprovar orçamentos de maior valor e apresentar relatórios financeiros com análises e planos de ação.
  • Gestão de contratos e fornecedores: negociar e revisar contratos, monitorar o desempenho de fornecedores, homologar novos parceiros, desenvolver alianças estratégicas e assegurar o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais.
  • Performance operacional: definir e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da frota (KPIs), analisar desvios e suas causas, garantir conformidade nos processos de inspeção e documentação dos veículos e alinhar a capacidade da frota às demandas operacionais.
  • Liderança e desenvolvimento da equipe: gerenciar a equipe de frotas, desenvolver competências técnicas, estruturar processos e ferramentas de gestão, realizar avaliações de desempenho e apoiar o recrutamento e integração de novos colaboradores.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO

  • Formação Graduação em Engenharia, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Operações, Supply Chain ou Gestão desejável
  • Vasta experiência em gestão de frotas e em posição de liderança (coordenação ou gerência)
  • Experiência comprovada com gestão de veículos elétricos de carga (BYD Cargo, Fiat Doblô Electric, Renault Kangoo ou similares)

title: Product Owner
description:

Buscamos um perfil analítico, organizado, com excelente capacidade de comunicação e influência, que tenha facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos, gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente e construir relacionamentos com diferentes stakeholders.

Se você gosta de desafios, inovação e de atuar em temas com grande relevância para o mercado, essa oportunidade é para você!

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência no mercado de seguros, previdência e capitalização;
  • Vivência com condução e gestão de projetos;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de stakeholders e parceiros;

  • Entendimento básico de resseguro e cosseguro;
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Direito, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Seu papel na Trillia:

No dia a dia, você irá:

  • Gerir projetos regulatórios e toda a cadeia envolvida, desde a geração de cards até acompanhamento de desenvolvimento e testes funcionais;
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em demandas claras para times de desenvolvimento e áreas internas;
  • Atuar como ponto de conexão entre áreas técnicas, jurídicas, produtos e tecnologia;

  • Acompanhar stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo integração e alinhamento entre as frentes de atuação.

Por que trabalhar na Trillia?

Oferecemos um pacote completo de benefícios, pensado para promover bem-estar, desenvolvimento profissional, equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e trabalho e segurança.

Entre eles:

title: Director of Ecommerce
description:
Company: Lime Vizio Inc.

Industry: Multi-Brand E-Commerce (US & Canada)

Location: Remote (outside the US)

Schedule: Full-time, Los Angeles business hours

Reports to: CEO & Founders

About Lime Vizio

Lime Vizio is a multi-brand e-commerce company operating across the United States and Canada.

We build and grow digital businesses in flowers, gifting, and local services, processing thousands of orders through proprietary technology, performance marketing, AI, and operational excellence.

We're looking for an experienced E-Commerce Director to drive profitable growth—not just increase traffic.

About the Role

You'll own the end-to-end digital customer journey across multiple brands, from acquisition through checkout, retention, and repeat purchase.

This is a commercial leadership role focused on improving conversion, customer experience, merchandising, experimentation, and profitability.

Success is measured by business outcomes—not website activity.

What You'll Own

  • E-commerce growth strategy
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Customer journey & UX
  • Merchandising & pricing
  • Checkout optimization
  • A/B testing & experimentation
  • Retention (Email & SMS)
  • SEO commercial performance
  • AI-powered shopping experiences
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Analytics, and Operations

Key Responsibilities

  • Increase gross profit, conversion rate, AOV, retention, and profit per visitor.
  • Build and execute the e-commerce growth roadmap.
  • Lead CRO and experimentation programs.
  • Improve customer experience across desktop and mobile.
  • Optimize merchandising, pricing, promotions, bundles, and upsells.
  • Improve customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
  • Work with PPC and SEO teams to maximize profitable growth.
  • Introduce AI-driven shopping and personalization where it creates measurable business value.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on commercial impact rather than activity.

Success Metrics

You'll be accountable for measurable improvements in:

  • Gross Profit
  • Profit per Visitor
  • Conversion Rate
  • Average Order Value
  • Checkout Completion
  • Repeat Purchase Rate
  • Customer Lifetime Value
  • Incremental Profit from Experiments

Requirements

  • 7+ years in E-commerce, CRO, Growth, or Digital Commerce.
  • 3+ years in an e-commerce leadership role.
  • Strong in-house e-commerce experience (required).
  • Proven success improving conversion, AOV, retention, or profitability.
  • Experience leading CRO, experimentation, merchandising, and customer journey optimization.
  • Strong understanding of unit economics and commercial performance.
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, PPC, SEO, Design, and Analytics teams.
  • Excellent English (B2+).
  • Available during Los Angeles business hours.
  • Based outside the United States.

Nice to Have

  • Multi-brand e-commerce
  • Marketplace businesses
  • High-volume online retail
  • WooCommerce or Shopify
  • AI-powered personalization
  • Behavioral psychology
  • Seasonal or event-driven commerce

This Role Is Not for Someone Who

  • Only manages website content.
  • Focuses on traffic instead of profit.
  • Relies entirely on agencies.
  • Treats CRO as visual redesign.
  • Reports problems without owning implementation.
  • Measures success through clicks instead of commercial performance.

What We Offer

  • Remote, long-term leadership role.
  • Direct partnership with the CEO and founders.
  • Ownership of commercial growth strategy.
  • Fast decision-making with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to scale multiple e-commerce brands using data, experimentation, and AI.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.

  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.
